shortDescription: Commander, we are trying to prevent a major evacuation of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We need you to go in and smash the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} evacuation area and prevent them extricating their forces. Wreck the defence protecting the evac zone and stop any convoy or lance trying to leave the area. This is a test for this mission shape. This is a large and complex mission.
longDescription: They are already on the ground. Get them off it.

dialogueContent.words: Heavy lance is down.
that's the Assault Lance taken care of.
Two {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lances are trying to hold the back door open for the retreating troops. Several enemy groups are inbound to the evacuation area. You need to stop them all.
You've done it, Commander. This is a total defeat for the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} troops.
A convoy has lifted off. The mission is a failure.
That's it Commander, the enemy is done, we can head to our own evac zone now.
Lance 1 is inbound.
Lance 1 is at the evac site now.
Lance 1 is away. We have failed.
Convoy 2 is moving.
Convoy 2 is on the extraction area.
Convoy 2 has escaped.
Lance 3 is coming in.
Lance 3 is getting ready to lift off.
Lance 3 has managed to get into orbit.
Convoy 4 is heading in now.
Convoy 4 is about to depart.
Convoy 4 has slipped through.
Lance 1 has lost a 'Mech. Keep it up.
Nice work, Convoy 2 has taken a loss.
Lance 3 is taking losses, well done.
Convoy 4 is damaged.
Lance 1 is at the lift point.
Convoy 2 is at the lift point.
Lance 3 is at the lift point.
Convoy 4 is at the lift point.
